entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: One of seven floating fortresses built by the ancient kor on Zendikar, shattered and reawakened during the Rise of the Skyclaves.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: Wild continent above which the skyclave hovered.

entities.name: Rise of the Skyclaves
entities.description: Event in 4561 AR when the skyclave remnants were reawakened.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who took the Lithoform Core from the Murasa Skyclave and pushed Akiri off a ledge.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: Member of Nahiri's party who warned her about the Core and was pushed from the ledge.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Member of Nahiri's party, killed in the explosion.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: Member of Nahiri's party who survived.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: Member of Nahiri's party who survived.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: Artifact buried in the Murasa Skyclave that Nahiri believed could restore Zendikar.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Adventurer whose party triggered the Emeria Skyclave's defenses.

entities.name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
entities.description: Aquatic beast possibly responsible for dragging the skyclave into the sea.

events.summary: The Murasa Skyclave is dragged into the sea by an enormous aquatic beast.
events.quote: The Skyclave over Murasa was dragged into the sea by an enormous aquatic beast

events.summary: Kesenya's party triggers the Emeria Skyclave and the Murasa fragments begin levitating again.
Nahiri leads Akiri, Zareth San, Orah and Kaza up to the skyclave seeking the lithoform core.
events.quote: Nahiri led Akiri , Zareth San , Orah , and Kaza on a perilous climb

events.summary: Nahiri seizes the Core despite Akiri's warnings, destabilizing the ruin.
events.quote: Nahiri seized it despite Akiri's warnings

events.summary: Nahiri uses the Core to destroy a Roil elemental, killing Zareth.
events.quote: Zareth was killed when Nahiri used the Core's power to destroy the elemental

events.summary: Nahiri paralyzes Akiri and pushes her off the ledge.
Nissa Revane and Jace Beleren rescue the falling Akiri with a bramble; they prepare to pursue Nahiri.
events.quote: she was caught midair by a magical bramble and rescued by Nissa Revane and Jace Beleren
